description: Find free dates at Vila Marcelka in a period (max 62 days): for each room the free date ranges (arrival–departure) of at least the requested number of nights. Use for questions like "when is something free in December for a weekend?". Then call check_availability for the exact price.

from.description: Start of the period YYYY-MM-DD (today or later).

lang.description: Answer language: cs (Czech), en, de, pl. Default en.

nights.description: Minimum length of stay in nights. Default 2.

persons.description: Number of persons in one room. Default 2.

to.description: End of the period YYYY-MM-DD (max 62 days after from).

name: find_free_dates
title: Vila Marcelka – free dates
